summary: macOS launch agents allow 30 seconds for a clean daemon stop, and shutdown logs report the duration of receipt draining, replication inventory saving, and telemetry shutdown.

replay.detail: No stored history or replay change.

schema.detail: No configuration schema or stored-state change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordination version change.

compatibility.detail: Home Manager-managed legacy smalltalk and Fractal macOS launch agents now allow 30 seconds for a clean stop before launchd sends SIGKILL. Receipt durability and shutdown stage ordering are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No additional daemon restart or activation is performed by this change.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the system-defined launchd exit timeout; no stored state is changed.
